shortDescription: 8-week three-day full body hypertrophy base-building program.
descriptionHtml:
8-week three-day full body hypertrophy base-building program.

Structure: 8 weeks, 3 scheduled sessions per week, 32 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Full Body #1, Full Body #2, and Full Body #3.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: beginner
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: full body and 3 days per week
